title: What are you doing?
subtitle: Saturday at Sam's café — the present continuous
canDo: I can say what people are doing now.
I can say what people aren't doing.
I can describe a picture in simple sentences.
teacherNotes: Present continuous'u ilk kez görüyorlar. Tahtaya: am / is / are + fiil-ing. Türkçedeki -iyor ekiyle karşılaştırın ama am / is / are kısmının unutulmaması üzerinde durun.
Pandomim oyunu: bir öğrenci bir hareket yapsın (drinking tea, sleeping, writing), diğerleri "You're …ing!" desin.
Arapça konuşanlar sık sık is'i düşürür (She cleaning). Türkler ise bazen -ing'i unutur (I am work). İkisini de hemen düzeltin.
Saat farkı detayı: Boston'da 11.00 iken İzmir'de 18.00. İsterseniz "What time is it in Izmir / Amman now?" diye sorun.

sections.title: Listen and read
sections.heading: A call from Izmir
sections.scene: Saturday, 11 a.m. in Boston (6 p.m. in Izmir). Elif is at work. Her mom calls.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Hi, Mom! Just for a minute. I'm working today.

lines.speaker: ayse
lines.text: Oh, you're at the café. What's happening there?

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: It's very busy. Sam is making tea for six people.

lines.speaker: ayse
lines.text: Who's that young man with the guitar?

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: That's Lucas. He isn't playing. He's writing a new song.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: That's Biscuit. He's sleeping under the table. He's always sleeping!

lines.speaker: ayse
lines.text: Here it's six o'clock. Your dad is watching football with Can.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Of course he is! And Pamuk?

lines.speaker: ayse
lines.text: Pamuk is sleeping too … on your bed!

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Sorry, Mom, two customers are waiting. I can call you tomorrow.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: My drawing: Saturday at Sam's
sections.intro: Elif draws the café in her notebook and writes about it.
paragraphs: It's eleven o'clock on Saturday, and the café is full.
Sam is standing next to the coffee machine. He's making tea again.
Two students are sitting by the window.
They aren't talking. They're studying for a test.
Lucas is sitting at the small table near the door.
He's writing a new song for his band, Blue Monday.
An old man is reading a book, and Biscuit is sleeping under his chair.
And me? I'm not cleaning the tables right now. I'm drawing this picture!

items.prompt: What is Elif doing right now?

sections.title: Grammar: the present continuous
look: He **isn't playing**. He**'s writing** a new song.
rules: **am / is / are** + verb**-ing**: for things happening **now**.
Spelling: work → work**ing**, make → mak**ing** (no e), sit → sit**ting**.
Short forms: I'm, he's, she's, it's, we're, you're, they're · isn't, aren't.

support.tr: Şu anda olan şeyler için am / is / are + fiil-ing kullanılır: I'm working = Çalışıyorum (şu an). Türkçedeki -iyor ekine benzer, ama İngilizcede am / is / are unutulmaz: She is sleeping = Uyuyor. Olumsuz için not: He isn't playing = Çalmıyor.
support.ar: نستخدم am / is / are + الفعل مع ing للحديث عمّا يحدث الآن: I'm working = أنا أعمل (الآن). في العربية نقول «هي نائمة» أو «هي تنام» بدون فعل مساعد، أمّا في الإنجليزية فلا بدّ من is: She is sleeping. وللنفي نضيف not: He isn't playing = هو لا يعزف الآن.

tr.note: Türkçede "uyuyor" tek kelime ama İngilizcede iki parça var: is + sleeping. İkisini de yaz.
right: Biscuit is sleeping under the table.

ar.note: لا تحذف am / is / are، ولا تنسَ ing في آخر الفعل.
wrong: They are wait for the bus.
right: They are waiting for the bus.

sections.title: Practice

support.tr: Present continuous ile tamamla (am / is / are + -ing).
support.ar: أكمل بزمن المضارع المستمر (am / is / are + ing).

items: Sam {is making|'s making} tea for six people. (make)
Two customers {are waiting|'re waiting} at the door. (wait)
Lucas {isn't playing|is not playing} the guitar. (not play)
We {are sitting|'re sitting} by the window. (sit)
Omar {isn't working|is not working} today. (not work)

items.audio: Sorry, Elif, I can't talk now. I'm at the hospital, and I'm very busy.
Tom! Stop it! You're sitting on my book!
Shh! We're listening to Pedro's new song.
OK, everyone, please sit down. We're starting the lesson.

sections.title: Write: Right now

model.heading: Right now — Omar
text: It's eight o'clock in the evening.
I'm cooking rice and chicken for dinner.
My neighbor's children are playing outside.
And my sister Lina is calling me on video … again.

sections.prompt: Look around you. Write about what you and other people are doing right now (5 or 6 sentences).

support.tr: Etrafına bak. Senin ve başkalarının şu anda ne yaptığını yaz (5–6 cümle).
support.ar: انظر حولك. اكتب ماذا تفعل أنت والآخرون الآن (5 أو 6 جمل).

checklist: I use one negative: 'm not / isn't / aren't.
I check the spelling: making, sitting.
